request.description: A credential that is well-formed, unexpired and correctly audienced, and whose signature does not verify against the issuer's published keys. Every shape assertion passes: the fields are present, the values plausible, the expiry in the future. Only verification distinguishes it from a genuine principal, which is why a consumer can satisfy every other fixture in this set by validating structure and resolving nothing. Fed to a resolver as-is, it separates an implementation that verifies from one that inspects.
